Product closure, rational versus real coordinate-change statements and algebraic matroid applications are separately attributed. Read full GHMSW pages11–12 and matching image. Corollary2.6 normalization-of-products uses exponent reversal, not normalization commuting with multiplication. prep = C / 'view_preparation_v1_20261007.json'
